<?php

namespace PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Writer\Xlsx;

use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\Information\ErrorValue;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\Cell;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\DataType;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\StringHelper;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\XMLWriter;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Writer\Xlsx;

class FunctionPrefix
{
    const XLFNREGEXP = '/(?:_xlfn\.)?((?:_xlws\.)?('
            // functions added with Excel 2010
        . 'beta[.]dist'
        . '|beta[.]inv'
        . '|binom[.]dist'
        . '|binom[.]inv'
        . '|ceiling[.]precise'
        . '|chisq[.]dist'
        . '|chisq[.]dist[.]rt'
        . '|chisq[.]inv'
        . '|chisq[.]inv[.]rt'
        . '|chisq[.]test'
        . '|confidence[.]norm'
        . '|confidence[.]t'
        . '|covariance[.]p'
        . '|covariance[.]s'
        . '|erf[.]precise'
        . '|erfc[.]precise'
        . '|expon[.]dist'
        . '|f[.]dist'
        . '|f[.]dist[.]rt'
        . '|f[.]inv'
        . '|f[.]inv[.]rt'
        . '|f[.]test'
        . '|floor[.]precise'
        . '|gamma[.]dist'
        . '|gamma[.]inv'
        . '|gammaln[.]precise'
        . '|lognorm[.]dist'
        . '|lognorm[.]inv'
        . '|mode[.]mult'
        . '|mode[.]sngl'
        . '|negbinom[.]dist'
        . '|networkdays[.]intl'
        . '|norm[.]dist'
        . '|norm[.]inv'
        . '|norm[.]s[.]dist'
        . '|norm[.]s[.]inv'
        . '|percentile[.]exc'
        . '|percentile[.]inc'
        . '|percentrank[.]exc'
        . '|percentrank[.]inc'
        . '|poisson[.]dist'
        . '|quartile[.]exc'
        . '|quartile[.]inc'
        . '|rank[.]avg'
        . '|rank[.]eq'
        . '|stdev[.]p'
        . '|stdev[.]s'
        . '|t[.]dist'
        . '|t[.]dist[.]2t'
        . '|t[.]dist[.]rt'
        . '|t[.]inv'
        . '|t[.]inv[.]2t'
        . '|t[.]test'
        . '|var[.]p'
        . '|var[.]s'
        . '|weibull[.]dist'
        . '|z[.]test'
        // functions added with Excel 2013
        . '|acot'
        . '|acoth'
        . '|arabic'
        . '|averageifs'
        . '|binom[.]dist[.]range'
        . '|bitand'
        . '|bitlshift'
        . '|bitor'
        . '|bitrshift'
        . '|bitxor'
        . '|ceiling[.]math'
        . '|combina'
        . '|cot'
        . '|coth'
        . '|csc'
        . '|csch'
        . '|days'
        . '|dbcs'
        . '|decimal'
        . '|encodeurl'
        . '|filterxml'
        . '|floor[.]math'
        . '|formulatext'
        . '|gamma'
        . '|gauss'
        . '|ifna'
        . '|imcosh'
        . '|imcot'
        . '|imcsc'
        . '|imcsch'
        . '|imsec'
        . '|imsech'
        . '|imsinh'
        . '|imtan'
        . '|isformula'
        . '|iso[.]ceiling'
        . '|isoweeknum'
        . '|munit'
        . '|numbervalue'
        . '|pduration'
        . '|permutationa'
        . '|phi'
        . '|rri'
        . '|sec'
        . '|sech'
        . '|sheet'
        . '|sheets'
        . '|skew[.]p'
        . '|unichar'
        . '|unicode'
        . '|webservice'
        . '|xor'
        // functions added with Excel 2016
        . '|forecast[.]et2'
        . '|forecast[.]ets[.]confint'
        . '|forecast[.]ets[.]seasonality'
        . '|forecast[.]ets[.]stat'
        . '|forecast[.]linear'
        . '|switch'
        // functions added with Excel 2019
        . '|concat'
        . '|countifs'
        . '|ifs'
        . '|maxifs'
        . '|minifs'
        . '|sumifs'
        . '|textjoin'
        // functions added with Excel 365
        . '|filter'
        . '|randarray'
        . '|anchorarray'
        . '|sequence'
        . '|sort'
        . '|sortby'
        . '|unique'
        . '|xlookup'
        . '|xmatch'
        . '|arraytotext'
        . '|call'
        . '|let'
        . '|lambda'
        . '|single'
        . '|register[.]id'
        . '|textafter'
        . '|textbefore'
        . '|textsplit'
        . '|valuetotext'
        . '))\s*\(/Umui';

    const XLWSREGEXP = '/(?<!_xlws\.)('
        // functions added with Excel 365
        . 'filter'
        . '|sort'
        . ')\s*\(/mui';

    /**
     * @var string
     */
    private $xlfnRegexp = self::XLFNREGEXP;

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlfn. where required.
     */
    protected static function addXlfnPrefix(string $functionString): string
    {
        return (string) preg_replace(self::XLFNREGEXP, '_xlfn.$1(', $functionString);
    }

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlws. where required.
     */
    protected static function addXlwsPrefix(string $functionString): string
    {
        return (string) preg_replace(self::XLWSREGEXP, '_xlws.$1(', $functionString);
    }

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlfn. where required.
     */
    public static function addFunctionPrefix(string $functionString): string
    {
        return self::addXlwsPrefix(self::addXlfnPrefix($functionString));
    }

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlfn. where required.
     * Leading character, expected to be equals sign, is stripped.
     */
    public static function addFunctionPrefixStripEquals(string $functionString): string
    {
        return self::addFunctionPrefix(substr($functionString, 1));
    }

    /**
     * Write a formula cell to XML, prefixing Excel functions where required.
     */
    public function writeCellFormula(Xlsx $parentWriter, XMLWriter $objWriter, string $cellValue, Cell $cell): void
    {
        $preCalculateFormulas = $parentWriter->getPreCalculateFormulas();
        $office2003Compatibility = $parentWriter->getOffice2003Compatibility();
        $spreadsheet = $parentWriter->getSpreadsheet();

        $formulaValue = $cellValue;
        $dataType = $cell->getDataType();
        $rawValue = $cell->getValue();
        if ($dataType === DataType::TYPE_FORMULA && is_string($rawValue) && $rawValue !== '') {
            $formulaValue = $rawValue;
        }

        $cells = $cell->getParent();
        $coordinate = '';
        $worksheet = null;
        $selectedCells = null;
        $activeSheetIndex = null;
        if ($cells !== null) {
            $currentCoordinate = $cells->getCurrentCoordinate();
            if (is_string($currentCoordinate) && $currentCoordinate !== '') {
                $coordinate = $currentCoordinate;
            }
            $worksheet = $cells->getParent();
        }
        if ($worksheet !== null) {
            $selectedCells = $worksheet->getSelectedCells();
            $sheetParent = $worksheet->getParent();
            if ($sheetParent !== null) {
                $spreadsheet = $sheetParent;
            }
        }
        if ($spreadsheet !== null) {
            $activeSheetIndex = $spreadsheet->getActiveSheetIndex();
        }

        if ($preCalculateFormulas) {
            $calculatedValue = $cell->getCalculatedValue();
            if ($worksheet !== null && $selectedCells !== null) {
                $worksheet->setSelectedCells($selectedCells);
            }
            if ($spreadsheet !== null && $activeSheetIndex !== null) {
                $spreadsheet->setActiveSheetIndex($activeSheetIndex);
            }
        } else {
            $calculatedValue = $formulaValue;
        }

        $prefixedFormula = (string) preg_replace($this->xlfnRegexp, '_xlfn.$1(', substr($formulaValue, 1));
        $prefixedFormula = self::addXlwsPrefix($prefixedFormula);

        if (is_string($calculatedValue) && ErrorValue::isError($calculatedValue)) {
            $objWriter->writeAttribute('t', 'e');
            $cellIsFormula = substr($formulaValue, 0, 1) === '=';
            if ($cellIsFormula) {
                $objWriter->writeElement('f', $prefixedFormula);
            }
            $objWriter->writeElement('v', $cellIsFormula ? $calculatedValue : $formulaValue);

            return;
        }
        if (is_string($calculatedValue)) {
            $objWriter->writeAttribute('t', 'str');
            $calculatedValue = StringHelper::controlCharacterPHP2OOXML($calculatedValue);
        } elseif (is_bool($calculatedValue)) {
            $objWriter->writeAttribute('t', 'b');
            $calculatedValue = (int) $calculatedValue;
        }

        $attributes = $cell->getFormulaAttributes();
        if (($attributes['t'] ?? null) === 'array') {
            if ($coordinate === '') {
                $coordinate = $cell->getCoordinate();
            }
            $objWriter->startElement('f');
            $objWriter->writeAttribute('t', 'array');
            $objWriter->writeAttribute('ref', $coordinate);
            $objWriter->writeAttribute('aca', '1');
            $objWriter->writeAttribute('ca', '1');
            $objWriter->text($prefixedFormula);
            $objWriter->endElement();
        } else {
            $objWriter->writeElement('f', $prefixedFormula);
            if ($office2003Compatibility === false) {
                $cachedValue = ($preCalculateFormulas && !is_array($calculatedValue) && substr($calculatedValue ?? '', 0, 1) !== '#')
                    ? StringHelper::formatNumber($calculatedValue) : '0';
                $objWriter->writeElement('v', $cachedValue);
            }
        }
    }
}

ob_start();
$xw->save('php://output');

part.text: The 5 failures pre-exist on the baseline and are unrelated. Final check of the change:

Fixed. The issue was in `src/PhpSpreadsheet/Writer/Xlsx/FunctionPrefix.php:14` — the `XLFNREGEXP` pattern matched function names anywhere in a string, so `days` inside `NETWORKDAYS` got prefixed, producing `NETWORK_xlfn.DAYS`.

The fix adds a negative lookbehind `(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.])` at the start of the regex, so a match only starts at a word boundary (or right after `_xlfn.`/`_xlws.` prefixes, which the alternation consumes before the check applies to the next character).

Verified:
- `FunctionPrefixTest` (13 tests) passes, including the `DAYS/NETWORKDAYS` cases
- End-to-end XLSX write check: `NETWORKDAYS(...)` stays unchanged, `DAYS(...)` → `_xlfn.DAYS(...)`, `NETWORKDAYS.INTL(...)` → `_xlfn.NETWORKDAYS.INTL(...)`, embedded/`_xlfn.`-prefixed forms still work
- Reader/Xlsx (150), Calculation DateTime (2703), Writer/Xlsx, and Functional suites pass; the only errors are pre-existing baseline failures (missing GD `imagejpeg` in the environment, and 5 unrelated `RowOnSpreadsheetTest` failures)
